title: Microsoft Security Agent Loop

steps.status: agent receives live system anomaly telem

caption:
Microsoft Security AI isn't just an LLM wrapper—it is an autonomous agent loop.

Here's how an agentic security architecture actually operates:

1. Runtime Logs — Live system telemetry and anomaly streams are ingested continuously by the central orchestrator.
2. Security Agent — Evaluates incoming incidents, coordinates execution flow, and enforces strict security policies.
3. Security Model — A specialized domain model evaluates context, classifies CVE vulnerabilities, and recommends precise remediation.
4. Patch Pipeline — The agent executes deterministic mitigation scripts inside an isolated sandbox before production rollout.

Why this matters: Enterprise security cannot rely on passive text generators—it demands autonomous detection with safe execution bounds.

No silver bullet—just disciplined agent orchestration with strict sandboxing.
